hook: Most budgeting apps claim they save you money, but Quicken Simplifi costs just $3.49 right now.

sections.voiceover: Most budgeting apps claim they save you money, but Quicken Simplifi costs just $3.49 right now.
CNBC Select evaluated over two dozen budgeting products in October 2026. Quartz reported on October 8, 2026, that three apps stand out. Where did that 50 percent discount come from?
That 50 percent discount is only for the first year.

CNBC Select lists the standard rate at $6.99 per month billed annually. Quicken Simplifi uses automated tracking features to keep spending on track. CNBC Select highlights Quicken Simplifi for beginners choosing a financial tool.
Quicken Simplifi renews at $6.99 per month billed annually.
